## About Ashley
* ### Ashley Furniture
  
  Shopping for new furniture and decor takes plenty of time and effort. We’re here to simplify your
  home makeover journey. You can find everything you need and more with just one stop at Ashley.
  Want to learn more about Ashley Furniture? Here’s a glimpse into how you can transform your home
  and save big!
* ### About Ashley Furniture
  
  At Ashley Furniture, we believe your home should be an extension of you. Our expansive collection
  of furniture and decor has something special for everyone. No matter your style or budget, we
  ensure you’ll find pieces that speak to you and reflect your personality. From standout pieces to
  timeless finds, we strive to help you create the ideal space to share unforgettable memories with
  your loved ones.
* ### What Products Does Ashley Sell?
  
  Whether you’re searching for the top mattress brands or giving your patio a much-needed update,
  you’ll discover incredible finds at Ashley Furniture. As the #1 furniture home store in North
  America, we have everything you need to complete your home’s aesthetic. Find unmatchable pieces
  and unbelievable deals on:
  * [ Living Room Furniture ][74]: Make your living area the ideal comfort zone with exclusive
    sofas, loveseats, sectionals, recliners, ottomans, and more.
  * [ Rugs ][75]: Explore rugs, pads, and accessories for any room at Ashley HomeStore. Shop rugs by
    size to ensure the perfect fit for your space.
  * [ Storage Solutions ][76]: Dealing with a small space? Our closet systems, clothing racks,
    shelving accessories, and more can make organization effortless.
  * [ Bedroom Furniture ][77]: Revamp your bedroom with our signature bedroom collections, dressers,
    nightstands, and makeup vanities.
  * [ Kids & Baby Furniture ][78]: Find everything for your child’s bedroom, as well as baby
    strollers, bathtubs, and play mats.
  * [ Kitchen & Dining Furniture ][79]: Create an inviting atmosphere in your kitchen and dining
    area with top-quality dining room sets, bar furniture, storage, and more.
  * [ Home Office Furniture ][80]: We’ll help you design an office space you’ll actually want to
    work in with our signature home office collections, desks, bookcases, and office chairs.
  * [ Mattresses ][81]: Ashley Furniture is home to top mattress brands, including Stearns & Foster,
    Sealy, Purple, and Tempur-Pedic. Complete your sleeping sanctuary with pillows, bedding,
    mattress foundations, adjustable bed bases, and more.
  * [ Outdoor Furniture ][82]: Deck out your patio with the hottest finds in outdoor lounge, dining,
    and bar furniture and accessories. We even have fire pits!
  * [ Decor ][83]: No home is complete without fabulous decor. Our extensive selection of home
    decorations, such as wall art, sculptures, home accents, and lighting, will delight your inner
    interior designer.
* ### Find an Ashley Store Nearest You
  
  Ready to revamp your space? Shop us online or visit us in-store to get started. We’re located
  nationwide, with over 1,000 Ashley stores across the globe! Find your neighborhood Ashley
  Furniture by searching “Ashley Furniture near me” on Google or visit our [ store locator here
  ][84]. Countless incredible finds await you!

* ### Ashley Furniture
  
  Shopping for new furniture and decor takes plenty of time and effort. We’re here to simplify your
  home makeover journey. You can find everything you need and more with just one stop at Ashley.

  At Ashley Furniture, we believe your home should be an extension of you. Our expansive collection
  of furniture and decor has something special for everyone. No matter your style or budget, we
  ensure you’ll find pieces that speak to you and reflect your personality. From standout pieces to
  timeless finds, we strive to help you create the ideal space to share unforgettable memories with
  your loved ones.
* ### What Products Does Ashley Sell?
  
  Whether you’re searching for the top mattress brands or giving your patio a much-needed update,
  you’ll discover incredible finds at Ashley Furniture. As the #1 furniture home store in North
  America, we have everything you need to complete your home’s aesthetic. Find unmatchable pieces
  and unbelievable deals on:
  * [ Living Room Furniture ][74]: Make your living area the ideal comfort zone with exclusive
    sofas, loveseats, sectionals, recliners, ottomans, and more.
  * [ Rugs ][75]: Explore rugs, pads, and accessories for any room at Ashley HomeStore. Shop rugs by
    size to ensure the perfect fit for your space.
  * [ Storage Solutions ][76]: Dealing with a small space? Our closet systems, clothing racks,
    shelving accessories, and more can make organization effortless.
  * [ Bedroom Furniture ][77]: Revamp your bedroom with our signature bedroom collections, dressers,
    nightstands, and makeup vanities.
  * [ Kids & Baby Furniture ][78]: Find everything for your child’s bedroom, as well as baby
    strollers, bathtubs, and play mats.
  * [ Kitchen & Dining Furniture ][79]: Create an inviting atmosphere in your kitchen and dining
    area with top-quality dining room sets, bar furniture, storage, and more.
  * [ Home Office Furniture ][80]: We’ll help you design an office space you’ll actually want to
    work in with our signature home office collections, desks, bookcases, and office chairs.
  * [ Mattresses ][81]: Ashley Furniture is home to top mattress brands, including Stearns & Foster,
    Sealy, Purple, and Tempur-Pedic. Complete your sleeping sanctuary with pillows, bedding,
    mattress foundations, adjustable bed bases, and more.
  * [ Outdoor Furniture ][82]: Deck out your patio with the hottest finds in outdoor lounge, dining,
    and bar furniture and accessories. We even have fire pits!
  * [ Decor ][83]: No home is complete without fabulous decor. Our extensive selection of home
    decorations, such as wall art, sculptures, home accents, and lighting, will delight your inner
    interior designer.

  nationwide, with over 1,000 Ashley stores across the globe! Find your neighborhood Ashley

**About Us**

With a foresighted vision to carve your dream Furniture into reality as per latest trends, we, **Sri
Anu Furnitures And Furnishing**, established ourselves back in **1994**. Since then, we have been an
accredited** manufacturer and wholesaler** of **Mirrored Dressing Table, Modern Dressing Table,
Restaurant Luxury Banquet Chair, Auditorium Chair, Solid Wood Canteen Dining Table, Pneumatic
Revolving Stool, Classroom Furniture and more**. All these are designed and carved to perfection by
our team of skilled and highly proficient craftsmen, designers, carpenters and other personnel. We
also have a widespread infrastructural facility at **Hyderabad (India)** and showrooms across 4
cities like **Chandanagar, Miyapur, Habsiguda and LB Nagar**. These cover an overall area of** 1
lakh 60 thousand sq. ft**.

Having gained a reputed hold in the industry with immense goodwill amongst the clients has been a
result of **impeccable quality and unmatched designs** offered in Furniture. Apart from these, the
**resistance from termite, wear & tear and dust **along with their **longer service life** are other
attributes that attract clientele and retain them with us. We provide value to our clients for their
investments and ensure complete satisfaction with timely deliveries, reasonable pricing and ethical
& transparent dealings.

**Milestones
**
We present the entire growth of our company below:
* **1994** - Establishment of first store at Chandanagar across 200 sq ft
* **2000** - Upgrading Chandanagar store to 20,000 sq ft
* **2010** - Further expansion of Chandanagar store to 50,000 sq ft
* **2011** - Inauguration of new store at Miyapur in 10000 sq ft
* **2012** - Inauguration of Habsiguda branch in 70,000 sq ft
* **2013** - Inauguration of LB Nagar branch in 30,000 sq ft
**
Quality Assurance
**
Our concern towards the aspect of quality is very high and we make sure that no flaws are made on
our side during production. The Hostel Study Table, Digital Safe Locker, etc., we provide our
customers are excellently designed under the supervision of skilled and knowledgeable designers
following international trends. Moreover, the raw material we make use of during the production
process of our products are responsibly procured from authorized source. Before dispatch, we
properly inspect all our products to ensure their match with international trends, global quality
standards and industry norms.

**Our Infrastructure
**
At our end, we have developed an ultramodern infrastructure, which includes all the latest facility
for designing and developing the offered range. The instruments, tools and machines for developing
our SS Hospital Baby Trolley, Electric Fowler Bed, etc., are all advanced. These amenities enable us
to come up with an excellent array of furniture. Moreover, we have made optimum arrangements for
inspecting our well-designed and manufactured products to ensure their perfection. After the quality
testing process, we transfer the perfectly finished products to our sound warehousing section for
their categorical storage.

##### **Address & Phone**

430 S. Franklin Road
Indianapolis, IN 46219
Phone: [317-357-1951][53]
Fax: 317-357-2129

##### **Showroom Hours**

Monday - Tuesday: 10am - 5pm
Wednesday: 10am - 7pm
Thursday - Friday: 10am - 5pm
Saturday: 10am - 2pm

##### **Receiving Hours**

By Appointment Only
Closed Sunday

##### **Warehouse & Office Hours**

Mon, Tues, Thurs, Fri: 8am - 5pm,
Wednesday: 8am - 7pm
Saturday: 10am - 2pm

# **Welcome to the AWF Website**

**AWF** began its partnership in both the retail and RTO Industries serving the East and Central
Midwest in 1986 from Indianapolis, IN.

We began with the simple business model of stocking deep the 20% of home furnishings that produces
80% of the business, with delivery to our dealers on the **same day every week with company trucks
and drivers.**

This simple model has seen continuous growth over the past 30+ years. We now have thousands of
valued partners in both industries and we deliver between 600-800 stores every week!

This website is another effort to be a good partner with our current valued and prospective
customers. Take a few minutes to look over the site and you will find photos of all of our product
and some helpful training videos.

Please send your orders and questions via Phone, E-Mail, or Fax and our customer service will
respond to you immediately.

#### **Most Orders Ship Same Week on Company Truck**

and warm young family space. The living room uses a low-saturation blue sofa with a soft warm light
to create a warm and soft halo, which injects a warm atmosphere into the entire space. The metal
coffee table group with multi-material fusion adds a touch of artistic flavor to the space, showing
a rich sense of hierarchy.

## Experts in furniture restoration

The Emmiera Group is Britain’s leading upholstery, bed, mattress and cabinet furniture repair
specialist. We carry out repairs at your home or business, and our specialists are on hand to
resolve any issues quickly and efficiently.

Trust the Emmiera Group’s expertise in furniture repair to breathe new life into your beloved
pieces, ensuring they shine just as they did before.

#### Property Solutions

We provide professional household property repairs, from landscaping and building to decorators,
carpenters and plumbers.

The Emmiera Group are the UK’s largest service provider for onsite re-upholstery and furniture
repairs to the restaurant, pub, hotel and leisure industry.

The Emmiera Group Limited is Britain’s largest and leading upholstery, bed and mattress and cabinet
furniture repair specialists.

We are an independently owned company providing on-site furniture repairs for retailers,
manufacturers, and wholesalers in the domestic market.

###### Our Award-winning services

## Experts in furniture restoration

The Emmiera Group is Britain’s leading upholstery, bed, mattress and cabinet furniture repair
specialist. We carry out repairs at your home or business, and our specialists are on hand to
resolve any issues quickly and efficiently.

#### Furniture Solutions

Trust the Emmiera Group’s expertise in furniture repair to breathe new life into your beloved
pieces, ensuring they shine just as they did before.

[ Explore Our Furniture Solutions ][128]

#### Property Solutions

We provide professional household property repairs, from landscaping and building to decorators,
carpenters and plumbers.


[ Explore Our Property Solutions ][129]

#### Commercial Solutions

The Emmiera Group are the UK’s largest service provider for onsite re-upholstery and furniture
repairs to the restaurant, pub, hotel and leisure industry.

[ See Our Commercial Solutions ][130]

### THE EMMIeRA GROUP

## The UK and Ireland's Largest Furniture Repair Network

The Emmiera Group Limited is Britain’s largest and leading upholstery, bed and mattress and cabinet
furniture repair specialists.

We are an independently owned company providing on-site furniture repairs for retailers,
manufacturers, and wholesalers in the domestic market.
* Over 150 technicians nationwide
* Centrally located head office
* 8,000 sq ft workshop and distribution centre

### From Timeworn to Timeless

## Transformation Showcase

At the Emmiera Group, we believe that every piece of furniture tells a story. Marvel at how we
lovingly bring worn out pieces back to their former glory, preserving cherished memories while
infusing new life. Our meticulous craftsmanship reflects in each restoration, proving that beauty
can indeed be rekindled.

[ Get Started ][132]
OUR TEAM

## Experienced and Fully Trained Technicians

All our friendly customer-focused technicians undergo a comprehensive training and induction
process. Each one is trained on-site in our dedicated technician training academy and has to pass a
comprehensive 136-point skills-set check. On the day of an appointment, customers receive regular
text and email updates to notify them when a technician will be arriving to repair their furniture.
Customers are also provided with a tracking link so they always know how close the technician is.
* Minimum 5 years of upholstery and repair experience
* DBS background checks
* ID Cards and the Emmiera Group branded vans

**Name:** Nigel Richmond
**
Position:** Furniture Technician
**Years at the Emmiera Group:** 7

Nigel Richmond is a skilled Furniture Technician with a tenure extending over 7 years at the Emmiera
Group. His craftsmanship shines through in upholstery, joinery, and polishing, while his sales
acumen ensures customer satisfaction and business growth. His dual capability as a technician and
sales professional has made him a valuable asset to the Emmiera Group, contributing significantly to
its reputation for quality and customer-centric service.

**Name:** Jason Saunders
**
Position:** Furniture Technician
**Years at the Emmiera Group:** 8

With an impressive tenure of 8 years at the Emmiera Group, Jason Saunders has established himself as
a cornerstone of our repair network. His expertise spans a multitude of areas: from the meticulous
art of cabinet polishing and repairs to specialised insurance work, including stain removal on sofas
and extensive cabinet restorations. Jason’s proficiency extends to rise and recline repairs, bed
frame rectifications, and the nuanced techniques of buttoning and mattress tuft replacement.

**Name:** Connor Garlick
**
Position:** Furniture Technician
**Years at the Emmiera Group:** 4

As a dedicated furniture technician at the Emmiera Group, Connor Garlick brings precision and
craftsmanship to every project. Representing the renowned standards of the Emmiera Group, Connor’s
expertise ensures furniture repairs and restorations are executed with unmatched finesse. Located in
Huddersfield, England, his proficiency not only reinforces the company’s commitment to excellence
but also solidifies its reputation within the UK. With a steadfast dedication to his craft, Connor
exemplifies the best of what the Emmiera Group stands for in the realm of furniture repair.

**Name:** Jack Whyley
**
Position:** Furniture Technician
**Years at The Emmiera Group:** 6

Jack Whyley’s journey in the world of furniture repair is nothing short of exemplary. As a Furniture
Repairs Service Technician at The Emmiera Group, Jack seamlessly blends technical expertise with a
profound understanding of furniture aesthetics. His dedication and passion for the craft are evident
in every restoration he undertakes. Serving at the forefront of the industry, Jack embodies The
Emmiera Group’s mission to repair and restore, ensuring every piece he touches regains its former
glory.

**Name:** Ian Wharmby
**
Position:** Furniture Technician
**Years at the Emmiera Group:** 8

Beginning his illustrious career as a service manager at DFS, Ian quickly showcased his adeptness in
handling dining and bedroom furniture repairs. This proficiency paved the way for further training,
allowing him to delve deep into the world of upholstery. Today, as a Service Technician at the
Emmiera Group, Ian brings his wealth of knowledge in both fabric and leather upholstery repairs to
the table, ensuring each piece he works on is restored to its prime condition.

# Who is Wholesale Furniture & Linens

Wholesale Furniture & Linens is a locally owned and operated furniture retailer offering commercial
quality furniture, mattresses, decorative items and bulk linens supplies at wholesale prices to East
Tennessee and Western North Carolina. Our contract quality mattresses are the same Jamison
mattresses used throughout the hotel industry and our specially made sleeper-sofas are built to
specifications for frequent use in the hospitality industry so it’ll withstand the rigors applied in
a short-term rental, AirBNB, or VRBO investment rental property. Our bulk linens provide outstanding
wear resistance to withstand daily washing.


To the investment property owner or manager we offer same day onsite delivery to broad [local
delivery areas][161] so that if you’re not available on site, our staff will deliver and set up your
purchases even putting sheets back on the bed making your property rental ready without you having
to be there.


Feel free to visit or contact one of our stores for personalized service:

# Who is Wholesale Furniture & Linens

Wholesale Furniture & Linens is a locally owned and operated furniture retailer offering commercial
quality furniture, mattresses, decorative items and bulk linens supplies at wholesale prices to East
Tennessee and Western North Carolina. Our contract quality mattresses are the same Jamison
mattresses used throughout the hotel industry and our specially made sleeper-sofas are built to
specifications for frequent use in the hospitality industry so it’ll withstand the rigors applied in
a short-term rental, AirBNB, or VRBO investment rental property. Our bulk linens provide outstanding
wear resistance to withstand daily washing.


To the investment property owner or manager we offer same day onsite delivery to broad [local
delivery areas][161] so that if you’re not available on site, our staff will deliver and set up your
purchases even putting sheets back on the bed making your property rental ready without you having
to be there.


Feel free to visit or contact one of our stores for personalized service:

### Affordable Furniture & Mattress Stores Near You Across Ohio, Kentucky & Indiana

Furniture Fair proudly serves Greater Cincinnati, Northern Kentucky, Dayton, Louisville,
Indianapolis, and surrounding communities with quality furniture and mattresses at guaranteed low
prices. Shop sofas, sectionals, recliners, bedroom furniture, dining sets, mattresses, and more with
help from our expert design specialists and Sleep Center team.

Need better sleep? Explore trusted brands including Tempur-Pedic and locally made Serta mattresses,
plus personalized comfort matching with our Sleep Center specialists.

We're proud to be a family-owned business serving Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana since 1963, helping
families create homes they love with exceptional value and service.

### Our Low Price Guarantee

Our Low Price Guarantee is available to customers within our local delivery areas, including
Northern Kentucky, Greater Cincinnati, Dayton, Indianapolis, and Louisville, KY. Please note that
prior sales, Hot Buys, Floor Samples, Tent Sale items, and Discontinued or Clearance Merchandise are
excluded from promotional offers and special financing terms. Additionally, promotional discounts do
not apply to Stickley, Serta, Stearns & Foster, Sealy, Beautyrest Black, or Tempur-Pedic products.

While we strive to ensure that product photos are as accurate as possible, slight color variations
may occur due to screen calibration. We make every effort to provide accurate pricing online;
however, in the case of any discrepancies, the price displayed in our showroom will be considered
the correct price. [Learn More About Our Low Price Guarantee][365]

### Important Information

We improve your experience with Furniture Fair by using Microsoft Clarity to see how you use our
website. By using our site, you agree that we and Microsoft can collect and use this data. Our
privacy statement has more details. [Terms & Conditions][366]

### Affordable Furniture & Mattress Stores Near You Across Ohio, Kentucky & Indiana

Furniture Fair proudly serves Greater Cincinnati, Northern Kentucky, Dayton, Louisville,
Indianapolis, and surrounding communities with quality furniture and mattresses at guaranteed low
prices. Shop sofas, sectionals, recliners, bedroom furniture, dining sets, mattresses, and more with
help from our expert design specialists and Sleep Center team.

Need better sleep? Explore trusted brands including Tempur-Pedic and locally made Serta mattresses,
plus personalized comfort matching with our Sleep Center specialists.

We're proud to be a family-owned business serving Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana since 1963, helping
families create homes they love with exceptional value and service.

### Our Low Price Guarantee

Our Low Price Guarantee is available to customers within our local delivery areas, including
Northern Kentucky, Greater Cincinnati, Dayton, Indianapolis, and Louisville, KY. Please note that
prior sales, Hot Buys, Floor Samples, Tent Sale items, and Discontinued or Clearance Merchandise are
excluded from promotional offers and special financing terms. Additionally, promotional discounts do
not apply to Stickley, Serta, Stearns & Foster, Sealy, Beautyrest Black, or Tempur-Pedic products.

While we strive to ensure that product photos are as accurate as possible, slight color variations
may occur due to screen calibration. We make every effort to provide accurate pricing online;
however, in the case of any discrepancies, the price displayed in our showroom will be considered
the correct price. [Learn More About Our Low Price Guarantee][365]

### Important Information

We improve your experience with Furniture Fair by using Microsoft Clarity to see how you use our
website. By using our site, you agree that we and Microsoft can collect and use this data. Our
privacy statement has more details. [Terms & Conditions][366]

[https://tricafurniture.com/app/uploads/2024/05/le-beaumont-sofa-C-3-1.jpg]

Shop the look

][100][

**Fjords**

Scandinavian simplicity, crafted for true relaxation.

This is comfort, perfected.

][101][

**Van Gogh Designs**

Canadian Made. Custom Built.

Distinctly Yours.

][102][

**Canadel**

Where Meals Become Memories.

][103]

Where it all began - Penticton, 1945.

Bill and Nora Guerard opened our first showroom on Main Street with a simnple belief; that quality,
craftsmanship and genuine service would always stand the test of time. That philosophy still guides
us today.

Growing With Penticton - 1960's

A move to Front Street brought a larger showroom, and more inspired displays. Though the space grew,
the vision stayed the same; treating every customer like a neighbour and every piece like it
mattered,

A second generation takes the reigns

By the 1990's Doug Guerard was carrying forward the vision his parents began nearly 50 years
earlier. The showroom grew, styles changed, but the family's promise of craftsmanship and care never
wavered.

Carrying the tradition forward

Three generations after Bill and Nora opened their doors, Guerard's remains a family business; still
rooted in Penticton, still defined by craftsmanship, service and care. Today Trevor and his
daughters Nora and Margaret represent the next chapter in a story that began back in 1945.

1945196019902020

We Are Here To Help

At Guerard’s, we believe in furniture for better living that lasts for generations. To help you keep
your pieces in top condition, we recommend reviewing our **Furniture Care Guide **below—you may find
the quick solution you're looking for! If you still need a hand, please reach out to us, and our
team will be happy to assist you.

Where it all began - Penticton, 1945.

Bill and Nora Guerard opened our first showroom on Main Street with a simnple belief; that quality,
craftsmanship and genuine service would always stand the test of time. That philosophy still guides
us today.

Growing With Penticton - 1960's

A move to Front Street brought a larger showroom, and more inspired displays. Though the space grew,
the vision stayed the same; treating every customer like a neighbour and every piece like it
mattered,

A second generation takes the reigns

By the 1990's Doug Guerard was carrying forward the vision his parents began nearly 50 years
earlier. The showroom grew, styles changed, but the family's promise of craftsmanship and care never
wavered.

Carrying the tradition forward

Three generations after Bill and Nora opened their doors, Guerard's remains a family business; still
rooted in Penticton, still defined by craftsmanship, service and care. Today Trevor and his
daughters Nora and Margaret represent the next chapter in a story that began back in 1945.

We stock close to 20,000 pieces of furniture in our four warehouses, and all are available for
immediate shipment. Though supply-chain issues do occasionally impact our industry, we try not to
accept or make excuses for such disruptions. Instead, we search for innovative and alternative ways
to provide the same quality product with little-to-no delay to our customers.

### Save Capital

Let us be your warehouse. We keep our stock full so you don't have to!

### Less Waiting

Get finished goods shipped within days, not weeks or months.

## Công cụ tính thuế nhập khẩu hàng hóa

Áp dụng cho Việt Nam. Người dùng nhập **Trị giá tính thuế** đã quy đổi. Công cụ hỗ trợ Thuế NK, VAT
và các thuế khác (TTĐB, chống bán phá giá, tự vệ, BVMT theo số lượng, và % khác). Kết quả làm tròn
đến **đồng**.

Mô tả hàng
Trị giá tính thuế *
Thuế NK %
VAT %
Chống bán phá giá %

Tự vệ %

TTĐB %

Khác %
BVMT: Số lượng hàng bị tính thuế
BVMT: Thuế BVMT/đv (VND)

Thêm dòng Xóa dòng Tính Xóa kết quả
**Công thức:**

    Thuế nhập khẩu phải nộp = Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu x Thuế suất thuế nhập khẩu
    
Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu = Tiền hàng + cước vận chuyển quốc tế theo điều kiện giao hàng + các kho
ản phải cộng/chi phí phát sinh cho đến cảng nhập.
    
Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt = Trị giá tính thuế thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt x Thuế suất = (Trị giá tính thuế n
k + thuế nk) x % TTĐB
    
Thuế chống bán phá giá = Trị giá tính thuế thuế chống bán phá giá x Thuế suất thuế chống bán phá giá
    
Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Trị giá tính thuế x Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Số lượng hàng x Thuế suất tuyệ
t đối
    VAT = (Trị giá tính thuế nk + thuế nk + thuế nk bổ sung + Thuế BVMT + Thuế TTĐB) * %VAT

## Công cụ tính thuế nhập khẩu hàng hóa

Áp dụng cho Việt Nam. Người dùng nhập **Trị giá tính thuế** đã quy đổi. Công cụ hỗ trợ Thuế NK, VAT
và các thuế khác (TTĐB, chống bán phá giá, tự vệ, BVMT theo số lượng, và % khác). Kết quả làm tròn
đến **đồng**.

Mô tả hàng
Trị giá tính thuế *
Thuế NK %
VAT %
Chống bán phá giá %

Tự vệ %

TTĐB %

Khác %
BVMT: Số lượng hàng bị tính thuế
BVMT: Thuế BVMT/đv (VND)

Thêm dòng Xóa dòng Tính Xóa kết quả
**Công thức:**

    Thuế nhập khẩu phải nộp = Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu x Thuế suất thuế nhập khẩu
    
Trị giá tính thuế nhập khẩu = Tiền hàng + cước vận chuyển quốc tế theo điều kiện giao hàng + các kho
ản phải cộng/chi phí phát sinh cho đến cảng nhập.
    
Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt = Trị giá tính thuế thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt x Thuế suất = (Trị giá tính thuế n
k + thuế nk) x % TTĐB
    
Thuế chống bán phá giá = Trị giá tính thuế thuế chống bán phá giá x Thuế suất thuế chống bán phá giá
    
Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Trị giá tính thuế x Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Số lượng hàng x Thuế suất tuyệ
t đối
    VAT = (Trị giá tính thuế nk + thuế nk + thuế nk bổ sung + Thuế BVMT + Thuế TTĐB) * %VAT

và các thuế khác (TTĐB, chống bán phá giá, tự vệ, BVMT theo số lượng, và % khác). Kết quả làm tròn
đến **đồng**.

Thuế NK %

**Công thức:**

ản phải cộng/chi phí phát sinh cho đến cảng nhập.
    
Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt = Trị giá tính thuế thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt x Thuế suất = (Trị giá tính thuế n
k + thuế nk) x % TTĐB
    
Thuế chống bán phá giá = Trị giá tính thuế thuế chống bán phá giá x Thuế suất thuế chống bán phá giá
    
Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Trị giá tính thuế x Thuế bảo vệ môi trường = Số lượng hàng x Thuế suất tuyệ
t đối
    VAT = (Trị giá tính thuế nk + thuế nk + thuế nk bổ sung + Thuế BVMT + Thuế TTĐB) * %VAT

## Comfort for every sit, stretch, and snooze.
* [ [Shop Brooks] ][109]
  
  ### Effortless Blend
  
  Comfort meets function with Brooks, its thinner back and smaller arms allow this style to blend
  seamlessly with any room.
  
  [Shop Brooks][110]
* [ [white fabric loveseat with a throw pillow and blanket sitting on it] ][111]
  
  ### Contemporary Classic
  
  Modern lines, sleek track arms and a tall foam back all come together to give Finley its neat and
  structured look.
  
  [Shop Finley][112]
* [ [tan sofa with colorful throw pillows & blanket] ][113]
  
  ### Versatile Style
  
  Lauren offers crisp, track arms blended with cozy, airy backs, showcasing a style crafted with
  comfort, quality, and value.
  
  [Shop Lauren][114]
* [ [tan fabric reclining sectional] ][115]
  
  ### Comfortably Cool
  
  A perfect blend of comfort and function, James features single-needle top stitching, pillow top
  arms, and a tall back that adds flair to any room.
  
  [Shop James][116]
* [ [blue fabric 3-seater sofa with chaise] ][117]
  
  ### Simply Sleek
  
  Piper's sleek, smooth, streamlined style fits in with just about any decor from ultra-modern to
  comfortably casual.
  
  [Shop Piper][118]

## Options made simple. Comfort made personal.
* [ [Free Design Services] ][119]
  
  ### Free Design Services
  
  Our expert designers make it easy to bring your vision to life by guiding you through the choices,
  planning, and process for any size space, at absolutely no extra cost.
  
  [Learn More][120]
* [ [Fabric Swatches] ][121]
  
  ### Free Cover Swatches
  
  Let us calm your mind about choosing just the right fabric or leather by sending complimentary
  samples of your top three favorites directly to your home.
  
  [Order now][122]

### Built strong. Tested Tough. Designed for you.

There’s a science behind creating comfort that lasts. Frames, cushions, and fabrics are carefully
designed. Skilled makers craft each piece like their own. And tests include 100,000 reclines.


[Learn More][123]

## Your Comfort Story Starts Here
* [Front of La-Z-Boy store]
  
  ### Come In and Have a Seat
  
  The friendly team at your local store makes shopping for furniture as comfortable as sitting in
  it, from finding your "ahhh" to customizing every detail.
  
  [ Choose Your Local Store ][124]
* [ [La-Z-Boy Financing] ][125]
  
  ### La-Z-Boy Financing
  
  On online or in-store purchases made with your La-Z-Boy Furniture Galleries credit card. Equal
  monthly payments required for 12 months. Minimum purchase may apply.
  
  [Apply Now][126]

### Armitage Sectional

A smooth, low-slung design and bold track arms give the Armitage sectional a chic minimal aesthetic.
Power controls elevate legs and recline backs to zero-gravity comfort. The headrests raise for

### Astor Rocking Recliner

Let’s just say the Astor is the equivalent of a “big and tall” chair. Rugged in its good looks, it
not only reclines, it rocks. You’ll feel safe and sound in its strong, plush arms and completely
comfortable leaning your head against its perfectly padded back. **Buy Now**
][15][
[Ava Rocking Recliner]

### Ava Rocking Recliner

With its sleek form, the Ava Rocking Recliner is a fresh take on a casual classic. Refined padding
wraps the armrests. A tall foam back and smoothly tailored chaise seat and legrest lend cozy
adjustable support, clean style and rocking relaxation! **Buy Now**
][16][
[Bellevue High Leg Swivel Chair]

La-Z-Boy

### Bellevue High Leg Swivel Chair

Its low-profile design features subtly flared track arms and a softly scooped, tight back. Welt trim
along the outside arms and loose seat cushion highlight Bellevue’s organic lines, while angled wood
legs add a vintage flair. Fun and functional, with a 360-degree swivel base, this playful chair
keeps you at the center of all the action. Choose your favorite fabric and wood finish for a totally
custom look. **Buy Now**
][17][

### Belmont Rocking Recliner

With wide, flared arms, the Belmont Rocking Recliner adds a welcoming air to any space. Welt trim
adorns the tall back and adds a soft curve to the arms. Adjust the supportive back, smooth chaise
seat and legrest to get cozy, or just rock and relax. **Buy Now**
][18][

La-Z-Boy

### Bennett duo® Reclining Sofa

With rolled cigar arms and a subtly scalloped back, our Bennett Power Reclining Sofa boasts details

## The Lane Furniture Company Legacy

Since 1912, Lane Furniture has been synonymous with American craftsmanship, quality, and exceptional
comfort. Founded by John Lane in Altavista, Virginia, the company began as the Standard Red Cedar
Chest Company with a simple mission: to create furniture that families could cherish for
generations. Those iconic Lane cedar hope chests remain treasured heirlooms in homes across America
today.

Over the past century, Lane has evolved from cedar chests to become one of America’s most trusted
furniture brands, particularly renowned for revolutionary recliner designs and comfortable motion
furniture. In 1972, Lane acquired Action Industries, marking the beginning of the Lane Home
Furnishings recliner legacy. Today, Lane recliners—including wingback recliners, power recliners,
rocker recliners, and big man recliners—represent the pinnacle of American comfort furniture.

The Lane Furniture company’s Altavista, Virginia facility continues to produce furniture using
time-honored techniques combined with modern innovation. From Lane leather sofas and sectionals to
bedroom collections and accent furniture, each piece meets the exacting standards that have defined
the Lane Furniture brand for over 100 years. When you choose Lane, you’re investing in a legacy of
American quality and craftsmanship that becomes part of your home’s story.

We’ve moved three times and it’s the one piece of furniture we’ll never part with. Lane Furniture is
worth every penny for American-made quality!”

needed new living room furniture, choosing Lane Furniture was an easy decision. The same quality and

— Emily R., Richmond, VA

## Lane Furniture – Frequently Asked Questions

Q Is Lane Furniture still in business?
+
Yes! Lane Furniture continues to operate and manufacture quality American furniture. While the Lane
Furniture company has evolved over its 100+ year history, Lane Home Furnishings remains committed to
producing furniture from its facilities. Lane is now part of United Furniture Industries, continuing
the legacy of quality craftsmanship that began in Altavista, Virginia in 1912.
Q Where is Lane Furniture manufactured?
+
Lane Furniture is proudly manufactured in the United States, with production facilities in Virginia.
The Lane Furniture company was founded in Altavista, Virginia in 1912 and continues to maintain its
commitment to American manufacturing and craftsmanship at Lane Furniture Altavista Virginia
facilities.
Q What makes Lane recliners special?
+
Lane recliners are renowned for superior comfort, durability, and innovative mechanisms. Features
include ComfortCore cushioning, precision-engineered reclining systems, hardwood frames, and premium
upholstery options. Lane offers wingback recliners, power recliners with USB ports, rocker
recliners, swivel recliners, high leg recliners, and big man recliners designed for larger
individuals seeking maximum support.
Q Where can I buy Lane Furniture?
+
Lane Furniture is available through Lane Furniture stores, authorized retailers, furniture stores
nationwide, and online through Amazon and other e-commerce platforms. Shopping online offers
convenient home delivery and often provides the widest selection of Lane Home Furnishings styles and
customization options. Search “Lane Furniture near me” to find local Lane Furniture stores in your
area.
Q Are Lane cedar hope chests still available?
+
Yes, Lane cedar chests and Lane hope chests remain available and continue to be cherished heirloom
pieces. These iconic Lane cedar hope chests are crafted from aromatic red cedar and feature the same
quality construction that has made them treasured family pieces since the Lane Furniture company
began in 1912. Perfect for storing blankets, linens, and keepsakes.
Q Can I customize Lane Furniture?
+
Yes! Lane Home Furnishings offers extensive customization options for furniture pieces. Choose from
over 1,000 fabric and leather options, select different cushion firmnesses, add power reclining
features with USB charging ports, and pick from various wood finishes. Contact an authorized Lane
Furniture store or dealer for custom ordering options.
Q What is the warranty on Lane Furniture?
+
Lane Furniture offers warranties that vary by product line and component. Typically, hardwood frames
are covered by a lifetime warranty, while recliner mechanisms, springs, and upholstery have shorter
warranty periods. Lane Furniture parts are available for repairs. Check with your authorized Lane
Furniture retailer or the specific product documentation for complete Lane Furniture warranty
details.
Q How do I care for my Lane Furniture?
+
Care instructions vary by material. For Lane fabric upholstery, vacuum regularly and clean spills
immediately with a damp cloth. Lane leather furniture should be cleaned with leather-specific
products and conditioned periodically. Wood Lane Furniture benefits from regular dusting and
occasional treatment with furniture polish. For Lane recliner parts maintenance, consult your
owner’s manual. Always refer to your specific Lane Furniture product’s care instructions for best
results.
Q What are Lane Furniture reviews like?
+
Lane Furniture reviews consistently highlight the brand’s exceptional comfort, durability, and
American-made quality. Customers particularly praise Lane recliners for their superior comfort and
longevity. Lane Furniture company ratings reflect over a century of satisfied customers who
appreciate the combination of traditional craftsmanship and modern features. Many Lane Home
Furnishings reviews mention that pieces last for decades, making them excellent long-term
investments.

## [ Lazyboy Power or Manual Recliner? Full Comparison ][13]

Choosing between a Lazyboy power recliner and a manual recliner is one of the biggest decisions you
will make before buying a new chair. At first glance, both options may look similar. They can share
the same general shape, plush cushioning, supportive back, and relaxing reclined position. But the
way they function in everyday use can feel very different.

For some people, a manual recliner is the perfect choice because it is simple, reliable, and often
more affordable. For others, a power recliner is worth the extra cost because it offers easier
adjustment, better precision, and added convenience. The best option depends on your budget, body
needs, comfort preferences, room setup, and how you actually use your recliner every day.

This guide breaks down the full comparison between Lazyboy power and manual recliners so you can
decide which one is better for your home. We will cover comfort, ease of use, durability, repairs,
price, features, room planning, maintenance, and who each type is best for.

## What Is a Manual Lazyboy Recliner?

A manual Lazyboy recliner is operated by body pressure, a side handle, or a pull lever depending on
the model. To recline, you usually pull the handle or release mechanism and lean back using your own
body weight. To close the footrest, you generally push it back down with your legs and body
movement.

Manual recliners are popular because they are straightforward and do not require electricity. They
are often chosen by buyers who want a classic recliner feel with fewer electronic components.

If you are new to the category, it may help to also read about the broader [benefits of Lazyboy
recliner][16] ownership before narrowing down the power versus manual decision.

## What Is a Power Lazyboy Recliner?

A power Lazyboy recliner uses an electric motor to move the chair into different positions. Instead
of pushing back manually, you use built-in buttons or controls to raise the footrest, recline the
back, and sometimes adjust the headrest or lumbar support depending on the model.

Power recliners are designed for ease, convenience, and more precise positioning. Many users like
them because they can stop the recliner at many different angles instead of being limited to a more
basic manual range.

Some power recliners also include added features such as USB charging, power headrests, power lumbar
adjustment, or lift assistance on certain mobility-focused models.

## Comfort Comparison

### Power recliner comfort advantages

A power recliner usually gives you more control over your comfort because you can stop the chair at
many points instead of being limited to a few basic positions. This can make a big difference if you
like fine adjustments while reading, watching TV, or resting. Some people do not want to be fully
upright or fully reclined. A power recliner gives more in-between positions.

Higher-end models may also include power headrests and power lumbar support, which can improve neck
and lower-back comfort significantly.

### Manual recliner comfort advantages

A manual recliner can still be extremely comfortable. In fact, many people love the simpler, more
natural reclining motion of a manual chair. If the chair fits your body well, comfort can be
excellent even without power features.

Manual recliners also appeal to people who prefer a traditional recliner feel and do not care about
tiny position adjustments.

### Which is more comfortable overall?

If your idea of comfort includes customizable positioning, power usually wins. If your idea of
comfort is more about cushions, seat fit, and simple relaxation, a manual recliner may feel just as
good.

## Ease of Use Comparison

This is one of the biggest differences between the two.

A power recliner is much easier to use for people with arthritis, joint pain, back issues, reduced
strength, or mobility limitations. With the press of a button, the footrest rises and the chair
reclines gradually. You do not need to yank a handle or push back with your body.

A manual recliner requires more effort. Some are smooth and easy to use, but others may feel stiff
depending on the model, the user’s size, and the chair’s condition. For healthy users, that may not
be a problem. For older adults or anyone with limited strength, it can matter a lot.

If you are comparing accessibility or maintenance concerns, it may also help to read the site’s
guide on [common Lazyboy recliners problems, solutions and parts list][17] to understand the kinds
of issues owners typically run into over time.

## Price Comparison

In general, manual Lazyboy recliners are more affordable than power models. That price difference
comes from the extra motorized components, electronics, wiring, and convenience features included in
a power recliner.

If you are shopping on a tighter budget, manual often gives you better value upfront. You can still
get Lazyboy comfort and style without paying for powered features you may not need.

If you are comfortable spending more for convenience, easier operation, and extra comfort
adjustments, a power recliner may justify the higher cost.

## Durability and Long-Term Reliability

### Manual recliner durability

Manual recliners are often viewed as simpler and therefore less likely to have electrical failures.
That does not mean they never break, but they usually rely on mechanical parts such as handles,
cables, springs, and linkages.

Because there are fewer electronic components, some buyers see manual recliners as the safer choice
for long-term simplicity.

### Power recliner durability

Power recliners can also last a long time, but they introduce more parts that can eventually fail,
including motors, transformers, control boxes, switches, and connectors. That does not automatically
make them unreliable. It just means there are more possible failure points over the life of the
chair.

If you want to understand common repair items, browsing a [recliner power switch][21] or a [recliner
power supply transformer][22] can help you see the kinds of components power chairs may eventually
need.

## Repair and Maintenance Comparison

### Manual recliner repairs

Manual recliner repairs are often more straightforward. Common issues include broken handles,
snapped release cables, worn tension springs, or footrest mechanism problems. Many of these repairs
are simple enough for handy owners to attempt at home.

Typical items people compare include a [recliner handle replacement][23], a [recliner replacement
cable][24], or a [recliner tension spring][25] when troubleshooting a manual chair.

### Power recliner repairs

Power recliner repairs can be easy in some cases, but they can also be more technical. A problem
might involve a faulty switch, loose power connection, bad transformer, damaged motor, or hand
control failure.

Sometimes the fix is simple. Other times it requires more careful diagnosis than a manual recliner
would.

### Which one is easier to maintain?

Manual recliners usually win for simplicity. Power recliners win for convenience, but not usually
for ease of repair.

## Power Outage and Outlet Considerations

A manual recliner works whether or not the electricity is on. That may not sound like a big factor
at first, but some buyers like knowing their chair is fully usable at all times without depending on
an outlet.

A power recliner needs electricity. You will need a nearby outlet, and the chair’s placement may be
affected by cord routing. During a power outage, some power recliners may remain in their current
position unless they include a battery backup system.

If you want cable management around a powered chair, it can help to browse [cord cover for
floor][26] solutions or a [surge protector power strip][27] for safer power setup.

## Room Placement and Space Planning

Both manual and power recliners need room, but the way they operate can affect placement.

Some manual recliners need body momentum and more natural movement when reclining. Some power
recliners move more gradually and precisely, which can feel easier in tighter layouts. Still, what
matters most is the actual clearance measurement for the specific model.

If you are trying to choose the right chair for your room, a [tape measure][28] is essential, and
some buyers also compare [wall hugger recliner][29] options when space is limited.

## Who Should Choose a Power Lazyboy Recliner?

A power recliner is often the better choice if:
* You want easy, button-based operation
* You have arthritis, back pain, or limited mobility
* You want more precise reclining positions
* You like premium features such as USB charging, headrest control, or lumbar adjustment
* You do not mind paying more for added convenience

the same general shape, plush cushioning, supportive back, and relaxing reclined position. But the
way they function in everyday use can feel very different.

For some people, a manual recliner is the perfect choice because it is simple, reliable, and often
more affordable. For others, a power recliner is worth the extra cost because it offers easier
adjustment, better precision, and added convenience. The best option depends on your budget, body
needs, comfort preferences, room setup, and how you actually use your recliner every day.

This guide breaks down the full comparison between Lazyboy power and manual recliners so you can
decide which one is better for your home. We will cover comfort, ease of use, durability, repairs,
price, features, room planning, maintenance, and who each type is best for.

## What Is a Manual Lazyboy Recliner?

A manual Lazyboy recliner is operated by body pressure, a side handle, or a pull lever depending on
the model. To recline, you usually pull the handle or release mechanism and lean back using your own
body weight. To close the footrest, you generally push it back down with your legs and body
movement.

Manual recliners are popular because they are straightforward and do not require electricity. They
are often chosen by buyers who want a classic recliner feel with fewer electronic components.

If you are new to the category, it may help to also read about the broader [benefits of Lazyboy
recliner][16] ownership before narrowing down the power versus manual decision.

## What Is a Power Lazyboy Recliner?

A power Lazyboy recliner uses an electric motor to move the chair into different positions. Instead
of pushing back manually, you use built-in buttons or controls to raise the footrest, recline the
back, and sometimes adjust the headrest or lumbar support depending on the model.

Power recliners are designed for ease, convenience, and more precise positioning. Many users like
them because they can stop the recliner at many different angles instead of being limited to a more
basic manual range.

Some power recliners also include added features such as USB charging, power headrests, power lumbar
adjustment, or lift assistance on certain mobility-focused models.

## Quick Summary: Power vs Manual Lazyboy Recliner

─────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────

─────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────
Ease of use      │Very easy, especially for limited mobility  │Simple, but needs physical effort  
─────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────
Position control │More precise reclining angles               │More limited position control      
─────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────

─────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────
Price            │Usually higher                              │Usually lower                      
─────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────
Repairs          │Can involve motors, switches, transformers  │Often simpler mechanical repairs   
─────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────
Best for         │Convenience, comfort control, mobility needs│Simplicity, budget, traditional use
─────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────

## Comfort Comparison

### Power recliner comfort advantages

A power recliner usually gives you more control over your comfort because you can stop the chair at
many points instead of being limited to a few basic positions. This can make a big difference if you
like fine adjustments while reading, watching TV, or resting. Some people do not want to be fully
upright or fully reclined. A power recliner gives more in-between positions.

Higher-end models may also include power headrests and power lumbar support, which can improve neck
and lower-back comfort significantly.

### Manual recliner comfort advantages

A manual recliner can still be extremely comfortable. In fact, many people love the simpler, more
natural reclining motion of a manual chair. If the chair fits your body well, comfort can be
excellent even without power features.

Manual recliners also appeal to people who prefer a traditional recliner feel and do not care about
tiny position adjustments.

### Which is more comfortable overall?

If your idea of comfort includes customizable positioning, power usually wins. If your idea of
comfort is more about cushions, seat fit, and simple relaxation, a manual recliner may feel just as
good.

## Ease of Use Comparison

This is one of the biggest differences between the two.

A power recliner is much easier to use for people with arthritis, joint pain, back issues, reduced
strength, or mobility limitations. With the press of a button, the footrest rises and the chair
reclines gradually. You do not need to yank a handle or push back with your body.

A manual recliner requires more effort. Some are smooth and easy to use, but others may feel stiff
depending on the model, the user’s size, and the chair’s condition. For healthy users, that may not
be a problem. For older adults or anyone with limited strength, it can matter a lot.

If you are comparing accessibility or maintenance concerns, it may also help to read the site’s
guide on [common Lazyboy recliners problems, solutions and parts list][17] to understand the kinds
of issues owners typically run into over time.

## Price Comparison

In general, manual Lazyboy recliners are more affordable than power models. That price difference
comes from the extra motorized components, electronics, wiring, and convenience features included in
a power recliner.

If you are shopping on a tighter budget, manual often gives you better value upfront. You can still
get Lazyboy comfort and style without paying for powered features you may not need.

If you are comfortable spending more for convenience, easier operation, and extra comfort
adjustments, a power recliner may justify the higher cost.

## Durability and Long-Term Reliability

### Manual recliner durability

Manual recliners are often viewed as simpler and therefore less likely to have electrical failures.
That does not mean they never break, but they usually rely on mechanical parts such as handles,
cables, springs, and linkages.

Because there are fewer electronic components, some buyers see manual recliners as the safer choice
for long-term simplicity.

### Power recliner durability

Power recliners can also last a long time, but they introduce more parts that can eventually fail,
including motors, transformers, control boxes, switches, and connectors. That does not automatically
make them unreliable. It just means there are more possible failure points over the life of the
chair.

If you want to understand common repair items, browsing a [recliner power switch][21] or a [recliner
power supply transformer][22] can help you see the kinds of components power chairs may eventually
need.

## Repair and Maintenance Comparison

### Manual recliner repairs

Manual recliner repairs are often more straightforward. Common issues include broken handles,
snapped release cables, worn tension springs, or footrest mechanism problems. Many of these repairs
are simple enough for handy owners to attempt at home.

Typical items people compare include a [recliner handle replacement][23], a [recliner replacement
cable][24], or a [recliner tension spring][25] when troubleshooting a manual chair.

### Power recliner repairs

Power recliner repairs can be easy in some cases, but they can also be more technical. A problem
might involve a faulty switch, loose power connection, bad transformer, damaged motor, or hand
control failure.

Sometimes the fix is simple. Other times it requires more careful diagnosis than a manual recliner
would.

### Which one is easier to maintain?

Manual recliners usually win for simplicity. Power recliners win for convenience, but not usually
for ease of repair.

## Power Outage and Outlet Considerations

A manual recliner works whether or not the electricity is on. That may not sound like a big factor
at first, but some buyers like knowing their chair is fully usable at all times without depending on
an outlet.

A power recliner needs electricity. You will need a nearby outlet, and the chair’s placement may be
affected by cord routing. During a power outage, some power recliners may remain in their current
position unless they include a battery backup system.

If you want cable management around a powered chair, it can help to browse [cord cover for
floor][26] solutions or a [surge protector power strip][27] for safer power setup.

## Room Placement and Space Planning

Both manual and power recliners need room, but the way they operate can affect placement.

Some manual recliners need body momentum and more natural movement when reclining. Some power
recliners move more gradually and precisely, which can feel easier in tighter layouts. Still, what
matters most is the actual clearance measurement for the specific model.

If you are trying to choose the right chair for your room, a [tape measure][28] is essential, and
some buyers also compare [wall hugger recliner][29] options when space is limited.

## Who Should Choose a Power Lazyboy Recliner?

A power recliner is often the better choice if:
* You want easy, button-based operation
* You have arthritis, back pain, or limited mobility
* You want more precise reclining positions
* You like premium features such as USB charging, headrest control, or lumbar adjustment
* You do not mind paying more for added convenience

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and

news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

## Recliner Medic

#### About Us

  

Is your recliner not working as smoothly as it once did? Having trouble getting up from a sunken
seat? Do you have a broken spring or mechanism that needs to be replaced? Or has your recliner just
stopped working completely? 



If the answer is yes to any of the questions above, your search for a solution ends here. 



Based in Markham, ON, Recliner Medic provides on site repair services for manual and electric
recliners and would be happy to bring life back to your favourite seat in the house! Why buy new
when it can be repaired as good as new for a fraction of the cost?



With over 30 years of experience in the upholstery industry, 20 years of experience as a certified
repair technician for a major Canadian furniture company, and 15 years of experience specializing in
recliner repair services, you can be confident in our ability to diagnose and repair your issue in
the quickest and most affordable way possible.



#### Our Services

We offer a wide range of services to meet your recliner repair needs. We use only the highest
quality materials and techniques to ensure your furniture looks its best and lasts for years to
come. 



**Recliner Repair services include but aren't limited to: **

 
* On-site repair & troubleshooting
*  Electrical component repair (Switches, electric motors, cables) 
* Repair or replacement of damaged mechanisms, springs, and seat and back padding
* Tightening and reinforcement of back of recliner
* Foot Extension repair
